children: Singapore's trade ministry said on Thursday it disagrees with the US Trade Representative's findings on its latest tariffs announcement and is very disappointed with proposed actions against Singapore.
The ministry urged the USTR to reconsider the proposed actions on Singapore and explore ways to reduce the tariff, it said in a statement.
